description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeesViewList class, which extends ViewList to implement the list view for employee records in the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods for initializing the list view, preparing the search form, generating the module title with breadcrumb navigation, and processing search requests.

classes.name: EmployeesViewList
classes.description: A view class responsible for rendering the list of employees, handling search form preparation, module title display, and list processing.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Initializes the list view settings, disables multi-select for non-admin users.

methods.name: prepareSearchForm
methods.description: Prepares and customizes the search form for employee records.

methods.name: getModuleTitle
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML for the module's breadcrumb title with optional help links.

methods.name: listViewProcess
methods.description: Processes search inputs and sets up the list view for display.

methods.name: processSearchForm
methods.description: Handles search form submission, generates search filters, and updates the view accordingly.
